How did this toddler's POV become one of Instagram's most-liked videos ever?

It all started with a simple question: what does the world look like from less than a meter tall? Using the Insta360 GO Series, Mengmeng's parents set out to find the answer. 47 million likes later, it turns out plenty of other people were curious too.
